description:
BOATS is a 29-track double album produced by Transgressive North, featuring exclusive tracks from A Sunny Day In Glasgow, Bear in Heaven, Califone, Capybara, Dan Deacon, Deerhoof, doseone, El Guincho, Four Tet, Gang Gang Dance, High Places, Jamie Stewart, Julian Lynch, Keepaway, Lucky Dragons, Marram, Matthewdavid, Max Tundra, No Age, Physical Forms, Ramona Falls, rRoxymore, Rustie, Slanter, Son Lux, Sun Airway, Taken By Trees, The Ruby Suns, White Hinterland, and YACHT.

​Each artist created their songs using samples of the Light Of Love Children's Choir, originally recorded for Marram's Sun Choir. As a result, BOATS is a diverse and kaleidoscopic concept-album with the children's voices at its core.

70% of profits from every sale of this double-album go to the charity Scottish Love In Action.

This album aims to get the voices of the Light of Love Children’s Choir heard across the world as part of the most exciting and innovative music today.
